claims.claim_text: The verified corpus fixes the Picard/Bianchi geodesic object and supplies primitive-conjugacy and inversion/unoriented vocabulary, but it does not thereby define a Gaussian-prime-ideal owner map.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not convert object identity or primitive-geodesic terminology into an owner-map or quotient-certificate claim.

claims.claim_text: The group-algorithm sources supply useful component interfaces, yet the frozen corpus does not instantiate one terminating exact level-(3) procedure for conjugacy, inversion, maximal roots, canonical unoriented owners, and serialized completeness certificates.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not treat general decidability, a presentation, a fundamental domain, or an adjacent-group algorithm as exact Paper-29 applicability.

claims.claim_text: Computational number-field sources support literal Gaussian ideal arithmetic and ideal-power witnesses, but they neither select a unique primitive-class owner nor replace loxodromic group-element root detection.

negative_constraints.rule: Keep ideal-power detection and group-element primitivity as distinct certificate layers.

claims.claim_text: The synthesis exposes an unresolved compatibility obligation: a source-defined map on an unoriented inversion-invariant class must select one literal member of a distinct conjugate split-prime-ideal pair without representative-dependent branching.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not weaken the frozen codomain to a rational prime, norm, residue, unordered conjugate pair, or composite ideal.

claims.claim_text: Phase 3 can turn the component literature into a fail-closed dependency graph and executable evidence obligations, but it cannot choose a mechanism, certify the quotient, compute S_H, establish novelty, or assign Route credit.

negative_constraints.rule: Describe next actions only as separately authorized obligations; never imply execution or a favorable result.

manifest_negative_constraints.rule: No novelty, priority, exhaustive-search, impossibility, theorem, computation, certificate-completion, or scientific-result claim.
Preserve the unit-speed level-(3) Bianchi flow, hyperbolic arclength, primitive loxodromic owner, power-as-repetition convention, and literal Gaussian-prime-ideal target.
Do not assign a formal Route-A tuple, advance A2, invoke Route B, or draft manuscript prose.
